theory: The booklet explicitly requires deriving the loan equation each time from the repayment geometric series, whereas the current steps teach direct substitution into a memorised formula. Add the initial balance, end-of-period repayment timing, expansion and geometric-series derivation to the method; state that the quotient requires nonzero periodic interest and that zero interest gives $A_n=PV-nM$. Restrict $nM$ totals to schedules actually comprising $n$ equal payments, account for a smaller final payment when applicable, and replace the unconditional claim that most early repayment money covers interest with a statement conditional on the loan parameters.
